purpose: 六名角色菜单画风比较，未接入游戏，待用户选择
method: built-in image_gen, one call per variant

variants.name: 挖神手绘风
variants.notes: 深色描边、概括体积、哑光材质，蓝灰暗部与暖橙照明。
variants.style: Input image 2 is the ART STYLE reference from the user's other game, not a layout or object reference. Translate its confidently outlined, carefully hand-painted non-pixel 2D game illustration to this group portrait. Deep charcoal contours with modest variation, broad simplified 3D-looking painted forms but unmistakably 2D illustration, controlled soft brush transitions inside large shape groups, matte fabrics and wood, blue-grey/navy shadows with warm cream and copper-orange domestic light accents. A readable warm sheltered-home feeling with a little unease. Stylized western/eastern hybrid adventure-game faces with strong brows, simple noses and understated eyes, no glossy bishonen rendering. Do not copy its arcade machines or bunker metal panels. NO photorealism, no plastic 3D render, no dense microtexture, no flat cel-animation imitation.

variants.name: 90年代动画赛璐璐
variants.notes: 简练动画五官、两阶硬边阴影、偏冷色板和轻微胶片质感。
variants.style: Redraw as an authentic 1990s Japanese traditionally inked and painted cel-animation film still. Highly economical facial drawings, planar noses, sharply designed asymmetrical hair clumps, specific adult anime facial construction, no modern glossy webtoon faces. Slightly irregular clean black animation outlines. Flat opaque base colors plus just ONE sharply bounded shadow color per material; small selective second shadow only at contacts. Ivory skin with cool mauve shadows, charcoal hair with one blue-black highlight shape, pale lavender grey dress, blue-grey room, warm white clothing and a scarlet door accent. Background has restrained hand-painted gouache perspective, character cells remain unmistakably flat. Very subtle photochemical grain and slight analog softness, no digital glow, no airbrush skin, no shiny lipstick, no decorative hair strands. A tense quiet held shot from an older mature science-fiction anime. Not a manga page, no screentones.

variants.name: 水彩水粉绘本
variants.notes: 纸感笔触、柔和边缘与留白，温暖而略带不安。
variants.style: Handmade watercolor and opaque-gouache narrative picture-book group portrait, exquisite but economical. Visible cold-press paper texture, restrained watercolor blooms, wet-on-dry edge variation, flat brush strokes and selective drybrush, translucent washed background and opaque gouache accents on faces and clothes. Thin broken dark blue/brown pencil-ink contours that disappear into paint, never smooth digital shading. Adult natural faces softly simplified into painted shapes, small expressive eyes, warm neutral pale skin, cool slate and lavender shadows, muted cream, sage and dusty blue; a small warm red door accent. Strong readable silhouettes and controlled edges around faces/hands, softer background edges. Maintain ordinary-home intimate storytelling, slight mysterious tension. NOT saccharine children, no chibi, no oily glossy digital concept art, no photoreal, no uniform faux noise overlay.

variants.name: 精细像素插画
variants.notes: 清晰像素簇、有限色板，保留六人辨识度和表情差异。
variants.style: A meticulously hand-placed high-end 2D PIXEL ART group portrait key visual, like a detailed 1990s adventure-game title screen. Construct everything from deliberate visible square pixel clusters on one uniform grid, equivalent to a native approximately 640 by 360 canvas enlarged cleanly to the requested widescreen output. Crisp stepped edges, controlled one-pixel outlines, precise clustered color ramps of 3-5 tones per material, limited cohesive 40-60 color palette. Selective sparse ordered dithering in shadows only. Pixel-drawn adult faces with distinct noses/brows and readable glasses, hair grouped into graphic pixel masses. Navy, slate, pale ivory, lavender grey, cream and scarlet accent. The pixel structure must be present on characters AND furniture/background, not a regular anime picture with a pixel filter. No smooth gradients, no antialiased painted contours, no tiny RPG sprites, no 3D, no words. Keep large portrait scale and six full distinct people in the exact source arrangement.
